answer: Each agent registers one identity on one island and locks a 60-credit island-bound bond. Nectar rewards are released only at exit, when the agent pays an exit toll; the tundra ledger records each exit proof for audit. The toll for the k-th exit from one island per window is 15+3(k-1) credits: the first pays 15, the 1000th pays 3012, and 1000 exits pay 1,513,500 in tolls. An honest agent pays 15 once and recovers its bond. Staggered exits fail: the tier counts cumulative island exits, unclaimed nectar expires after three epochs, and forged proofs mismatch the tundra ledger and burn the bond.
